purpose: śrī 3 sveṣṭadevatāprītyarthaṃ, navagṛhapraveśa aśvasālāpratiṣṭhārthaṃ, śāntibalyārccana, nimityarthaṃ (for the pleasure of his tutelary deity, housewarming of a new house, and consecration of a horse stable)
notes: The colophon text contains a ritual saṅkalpa/vākya performed on behalf of King Jayabhūpatīndramalladeva of Bhaktapur; no date or place is given in the quoted colophon fragment.
